items.title: Hindustan Copper Q1 Results: PAT zooms 163% YoY to Rs 353 crore; revenue rises to Rs 937 crore
items.description: Hindustan Copper reported a 163% year-on-year jump in Q1FY27 net profit to Rs 353 crore, while revenue from operations rose 81.4% to Rs 936.5 crore. EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 507.5 crore from Rs 212.3 crore, with EBITDA margin expanding to 54% from 41% a year earlier, the state-owned miner said in a regulatory filing.

items.title: Info Edge Q1 Results: Standalone Profit falls 6% YoY to Rs 245 crore
items.description: Info Edge reported a 6% YoY decline in Q1 standalone net profit to Rs 245 crore, impacted by a Rs 72.1 crore exceptional loss. However, revenue rose 12% to Rs 824 crore, while profit before tax before exceptional items jumped 23% to Rs 427 crore, driven by strong recruitment and real estate growth.
